title: This Snail Can Kill You With One Sting (There's No Antivenom)

scenes.text: This snail can kill you with one sting. There's no antivenom.
The geography cone. Six inches long. Hunts fish with a harpoon.
It fires a venom loaded tooth, and the fish is paralysed in seconds. Swallowed whole.
It also sprays a cloud of insulin. Nearby fish crash into a sugar coma before they see it.
Over a hundred toxins. In people they shut down the muscles. Several have died.
One of those toxins is now a painkiller a thousand times stronger than morphine. From a snail.

description:
The geography cone snail is the most venomous of roughly 500 cone snail species, and there is no antivenom for its sting.
It hunts fish by firing a harpoon-like tooth loaded with over a hundred toxins that paralyse prey within seconds, and it can release a cloud of insulin that sends nearby fish into a low-blood-sugar stupor. Several human deaths have been attributed to it. One of its venom proteins became a painkiller about a thousand times more powerful than morphine, and not addictive.
Would you pick up a pretty shell on a reef? Comment below.
first_comment: Divers call it the cigarette snail: the joke is that after a sting you have about enough time to smoke one. Which looks more dangerous to you, a shark or a seashell?
